promise: Complete Ghana's IMF programme and exit the bailout by April 2026
description: Mahama expected Ghana to exit the borrowing programme by April 2026. The IMF Board completed the sixth and final ECF review on July 27, 2026 and approved a non-financing Policy Coordination Instrument, later than that expectation.
evidence: The May 15, 2026 staff agreement required Board approval; the final Board decision came July 27, 2026.

review.note: The April exit expectation is reported in February coverage. May 15 was staff agreement, not programme completion: Board completion was July 27. The exact February 5 speech day is not established by the February 6 video and February 14 newsletter.
